title: Optimize quantized kernels (INT8/FP8) and dequant-fusion path; improve KV-cache & continuous batching throughput
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: improve end-to-end serving throughput for quantized models (INT8 and experimental FP8 profile) while keeping latency and quality stable. This PR implements a fused dequantization+GEMM execution path, refactors the smoothquant pre/post scaling into the kernel hot path to avoid extra memory passes, and adds scheduler hints to the continuous batcher so quantized requests are coalesced into optimized kernel launches. We also add lightweight KV-cache prefetching and eviction heuristics to reduce cache thrash for long-running chat sessions. Changes are guarded behind runtime flags and per-model quant-profiles. Summary of impact: up to 1.9x throughput on small-batch short-sequence workloads for INT8, 1.6x for FP8 in our internal benchmarks, ~10% memory reduction and no measurable quality regression on the internal eval set. Includes unit and e2e tests and a perf benchmark harness. This description includes implementation details, motivation, and high-level benchmarking notes.
commits: Initial implementation of fused dequant+matmul kernel (kernel/quant_fused.cu): add opt paths for INT8->FP32 dequant and FP8->FP32 conversion inline
Refactor smoothquant scaling into kernel hot path and add per-channel scale bookkeeping
Add continuous-batcher scheduler hints and quant-aware coalescing logic (runtime/batcher.cc)
KV-cache prefetching and eviction heuristics to reduce cache misses for long sessions (runtime/kvcache.cc)
Add unit tests and perf harness for quant kernels; update CI to run quant perf check on linux-gpu job
Address review comments: tune threadpool granularity, add fallback to fp16 kernels for long sequences, reduce register pressure in fused kernel
review_comments: Diego Martinez (reviewer): Nice approach. Can you quantify the FP8 error distribution vs fp16 baseline and add a small eval run?
Ava Chen (author): Added FP8->FP32 MSE and top-k pass/fail eval in tests/perf and included results in PR description; numbers are in line with expectations (no regression in pass rate).
Priya Kapoor (reviewer): Concern about register pressure on A100; please add a fallback path and tune launch config.
Ava Chen (author): Added fallback to existing fp16 kernel for sequences > 2048 and reduced unrolling to drop register usage, see commit 'Address review comments'.
Lucas Wang (reviewer): CI flaky on quant perf job, ran again and passed after minor timing tolerance adjustment. Approving after CI green.
release_notes: Optimized quantized inference kernels: fused dequant+matmul, smoothquant hot-path integration, KV-cache prefetching, and quant-aware continuous-batcher coalescing. Up to 1.9x throughput for INT8 and 1.6x for FP8 in internal benchmarks. Enabled behind runtime flags and per-model profiles.
notes_for_ops: Feature gated by runtime flag --enable-quant-fused; ops teams should enable on staging and run quant-perf job before promoting to production. FP8 is experimental: enable per-model with 'quant_profile: fp8-experimental'.
